pro_course_detail.title: A1-A2 English Immersion Course
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed for beginner to lower-intermediate learners who want to build confidence in speaking, listening, and understanding English through real-life practice. Instead of memorizing grammar rules in isolation, you'll immerse yourself in the language with engaging conversations, practical exercises, and interactive activities.
What You’ll Learn:

Speaking & Pronunciation – Improve fluency through guided conversations, role-plays, and pronunciation exercises.
Listening & Comprehension – Develop your ability to understand natural spoken English with audio clips, dialogues, and discussions.
Vocabulary Expansion – Learn essential words and phrases for daily life, travel, and common social situations.
Grammar in Context – Practice key grammar structures in a natural way through conversation, not just drills.
Confidence in Communication – Overcome hesitation and learn strategies for expressing yourself clearly and effectively.
Course Structure:

Tailored Lessons – Each session is adapted to your level, needs, and learning goals.
Real-World Scenarios – Learn English in practical contexts like ordering food, asking for directions, making small talk, and more.
Interactive & Engaging Activities – Role-plays, listening exercises, Q&A sessions, and storytelling to keep learning dynamic.
Support & Feedback – Get corrections and guidance to improve your accuracy and confidence.

By the end of this course, you'll feel more comfortable using English in everyday situations and ready to take the next step in your language learning journey!

pro_course_detail.title: C1 & C2 Advanced Business English Course
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed for advanced learners who want to refine their professional English skills and communicate with confidence in a business environment. Whether you need to improve your fluency for meetings, presentations, negotiations, or networking, this course will help you master the nuances of business English in a practical and engaging way.
What You’ll Learn:

✅ Fluent & Professional Communication – Express ideas clearly, persuasively, and naturally in formal and informal business settings.
✅ Advanced Business Vocabulary – Expand your knowledge of industry-specific terms, idiomatic expressions, and corporate jargon.
✅ Effective Writing Skills – Improve your ability to write professional emails, reports, proposals, and business correspondence.
✅ Presentation & Public Speaking – Learn techniques to deliver engaging presentations, pitch ideas, and speak confidently in front of an audience.
✅ Negotiation & Persuasion – Develop strategies for handling business discussions, negotiations, and conflict resolution.
✅ Cross-Cultural Communication – Understand cultural differences in business etiquette and communication styles.
Course Structure:

🔹 Customized Lessons – Tailored to your industry, job role, and professional goals.
🔹 Real-World Scenarios – Practice through case studies, mock meetings, role-plays, and business simulations.
🔹 Advanced Listening & Reading Exercises – Work with authentic business materials, TED Talks, articles, and reports to enhance comprehension.
🔹 Practical Feedback & Coaching – Receive personalized corrections, insights, and strategies to improve your business communication skills.

By the end of this course, you will have the language tools and confidence to navigate high-level business interactions with ease and professionalism.

pro_course_detail.description:
Improve your current writing project and your ability to write in English at the same time.

A native speaker who is also a writing expert, can see things in your writing that may be impossible for you to see.

You have a unique voice and I will help you express it the best you can, while keeping in mind your specific readership and context.

Here's how it works: 

Send me your document and I will:

• Correct errors both grammatical and idiomatic (of course)
• Improve fluency and readability while retaining your personal style
• Improve structure and clarity (to strengthen your arguments)
• Adapt word choice to setting 
• Review citations and formatting

All kinds of writing!
• University admissions essays
• Academic writing
• Presentations & speeches
• Letters & emails
• CVs & portfolios
• Creative writing
• Etc.

Your text will show all changes I have made, and if significant structural revisions are needed, I will send you the new version in a separate document.

One class = ±500 words of text. Your text will be returned within 48 hours of reception. 

Your text must be in .docx, .odt, or .pages format.

Note that there will be *no videoconference*. However, you can always book a conversation class to discuss your writing.
